In [[20 BBY/Legends|19.1 BBY]],<ref name="Sabotage Date" /> a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was subjected to a '''bombing''' which saw the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of six [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as well as [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Technician/Legends|maintenance crew]]. It was suspected that [[Jackar Bowmani/Legends|Jackar Bowmani]], a worker at the Temple was responsible, until it was discovered that his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]], who fed [[Nano-droid/Legends|nano-droids]] to her husband, was responsible for the explosion.<ref name="Sabotage" />

She later told Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], shortly after the former's arrest, that the one who planned the explosion was actually a disgruntled member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], although she was killed via a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force choke]] before she could divulge the Jedi's identity, also leading to Tano's being framed for her death.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" />

The reason for the bombing was attributed to the growing mistrust of the population of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] for the Jedi Order.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" />

It was later discovered by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] that [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and that it was she who destroyed the Temple hangar. After a [[Duel at the Jedi Temple/Legends|duel]] in the Temple itself, Offee was defeated and taken into custody.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" />
